changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetFieldRelationship') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[AssetFieldRelationship]( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationAssetFieldRelationship_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [SynchedAssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [SourceID] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [FieldName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [AssetSourceType] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [AssetSourceID] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [IsSubject] [bit] NOT NULL, [IntersectTypeID] [int] NULL, [SubjectID] [bigint] NULL, [ObjectID] [bigint] NULL, [IntersectID] [int] NULL, [Present] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationAssetFieldRelationship_Present] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [Action] [varchar](1) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationAssetFieldRelationship] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
